name: Otaria Chasm
description: Part of the Aboshan Trench where Laquatus holed up and was sealed in.

description_citations.text: "Llawan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Llawan has Rillu Veza plant portal crystals in the Otaria Chasm as a trap for Laquatus.
timeline.quote: who had her advisor Rillu Veza survey the new Mer land and plant portal crystals in the Otaria Chasm

citation.text: "Aboshan Trench", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus is lured by a false map into the Otaria Chasm and trapped; he escapes into Krosa but his army is wiped out by Llawan.
timeline.quote: his army was wiped out by Llawan in the meantime, leading to Laquatus's downfall in the forest

citation.text: "Aboshan Trench", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus's Mirari quest fails; Llawan imprisons him in the Otaria Chasm and destroys his army.
timeline.quote: Laquatus ended up imprisoned in the Otaria Chasm by Llawan

citation.text: "Laquatus", section "The Battle for the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Llawan and Laquatus fight an open civil war, Laquatus holing up in the Otaria Chasm.
timeline.quote: The two fought an open civil war under the waves

citation.text: "Llawan", section "Civil war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus uses Chainer's dementia beasts; Llawan leads her leviathan, and Chainer's death makes the beasts vanish.
timeline.quote: Llawan led her leviathan into battle

citation.text: "Llawan", section "Civil war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Llawan and Olsham seal the chasm with a portal barrier, trapping Laquatus's forces; the chasm's value was a ruse.

citation.text: "Llawan", section "Civil war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
